name: org.citizenofnowhere.rankings/global-metro-power-rankings
title: Global Metro Power Rankings
description: Metro power rankings (4,300+ metros) and Elo ratings: NFL, college football, world football

tools.name: get_metro
tools.description: Full profile for one metro in the Global Metro Power Rankings: rank, score, every dimension value and rank, teams, universities, culture, luxury hospitality, events, market cap, and more. Use search_metros first if you don't know the exact slug.

slug.description: URL slug for the metro, e.g. 'new-york', 'london', 'san-francisco-san-jose'

tools.name: list_top_metros
tools.description: Ranked list of metros from the Global Metro Power Rankings composite, optionally filtered by region or country. Returns lightweight summary rows (rank, slug, name, country, region, score, population). Call get_metro for full detail on any one metro. Capped at 200 rows per call.

n.description: Number of metros to return, max 200

region.description: Filter by region name, e.g. 'North America', 'Europe'

country.description: Filter by country name, e.g. 'United States'

tools.name: search_metros
tools.description: Case-insensitive search over metro name, primary city, and country. Use this to find a metro's exact slug before calling get_metro or compare_metros.

tools.name: compare_metros
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two to 4 metros across every scoring dimension, with the leader in each dimension flagged.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: The weighted dimensions behind the Global Metro Power Rankings composite score: what each measures, its weight/shape in the formula, and its upstream data source.

tools.name: list_elo_leagues
tools.description: The leagues whose Elo ratings this site publishes (NFL, college football, World Club Elo, men's and women's international football), with each one's ratings date, team count, season range and human page.

tools.name: get_season_table
tools.description: One league's Elo table: rank, team, rating (and an NFL record, a college z-score or a club's country). The current table by default; nfl (1920 on) and cfb (1869 on) also take a past season.

league.description: One of: nfl, cfb, world-club, international-men, international-women

season.description: A past season, nfl and cfb only

tools.name: get_team_rating
tools.description: One team's current Elo rating and rank in a league (or in a past nfl/cfb season), with its recent season history for nfl and cfb. The team may be a slug ('kansas-city-chiefs', 'alabama-cfb') or a name ('Chiefs', 'Bayern').

league.description: One of: nfl, cfb, world-club, international-men, international-women

season.description: A past season, nfl and cfb only
